# Last9

> Comprehensive documentation for Last9's observability platform.

Last9 is an observability platform built for high-cardinality telemetry. It offers a developer-first control plane to manage logs, metrics, and traces, supporting OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and over 100 integrations. With real-time alerting, data pipelines, and AI-native features like the MCP server, Last9 helps engineering teams debug, optimize, and scale systems efficiently.
Our documentation covers everything from getting started to advanced integrations and features.

Key facts:
- Supports OpenTelemetry, Prometheus remote write, AWS CloudWatch, Datadog agent protocol
- MCP server available for AI agent integration with Last9 data
- Usage-based pricing with no per-seat fees
- Named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Observability

- [High Cardinality Guide](https://last9.io/guides/high-cardinality/): 8-part guide to high-cardinality observability: concepts, dimensionality, streaming aggregation, cost control, and anti-patterns
- [High Cardinality in Prometheus](https://last9.io/blog/how-to-manage-high-cardinality-metrics-in-prometheus/): How to find and reduce high-cardinality metrics in Prometheus: tsdb status checks, relabeling, aggregation, and scrape limits
